vo: بالحلقة الماضية... شفت ظل يتحرك آخر الزقاق.
img: View over his shoulder: his flashlight beam lights a dark alley and a shadowy figure at the end. Background: photorealistic dark Baghdad alley at night, dust in the beam.

vo: تقرّب اللايت... وتطلع المفاجأة.
ابن الجيران، علي... ماسك ورقة، ويلهث.
img: A skinny teenage boy 2D cartoon with a round white head, short black hair, white school shirt, caught in the flashlight beam holding a paper, out of breath. The hero stands in front of him relieved. Background: photorealistic dark Baghdad alley at night.

vo: يگلك: نزل إعلان من الوزارة... الامتحانات الوزارية بموعدها. بعد أسبوع.
img: Close-up of the paper notice in the teenage boy's hands lit by flashlight, the hero reads it with shocked wide eyes. Background: dark alley, dust in the beam.

vo: بدون كهرباء؟ بدون إنترنت؟ وبهالحر؟
img: The hero puts his hands on his head in disbelief in the dark alley, the teenage boy shrugs. Background: photorealistic dark Baghdad alley, moonlight.

vo: اليوم الثاني.
الساعة خمسة الصبح... تحاول تدرس قبل ما الشمس تحمى.
img: He sits on the rooftop at dawn with an open textbook on his knees, yawning, tired eyes. Background: photorealistic Baghdad rooftop at dawn, orange sky, minaret silhouette.

vo: الكتب مفتوحة، بس عقلك بالثلاجة اللي خاست والماي اللي خلص.
img: Close-up of him staring blankly at a textbook with chemistry formulas, distracted, thought bubbles not drawn. Background: photorealistic rooftop at sunrise, soft light.

vo: الساعة تسعة، الحرارة صارت أربعة وأربعين.
img: He sits under a small patch of shade on the rooftop fanning himself with a notebook, sweat pouring. Background: photorealistic Baghdad rooftop under harsh morning sun, heat haze.

vo: الحبر يسيح من العرگ، والورگ يلزگ بإيدك.
img: Close-up of his black mitten hand on a notebook page with smeared ink and sweat drops. Background: photorealistic wooden desk in a hot room, harsh light.

vo: تنزل للغرفة... بس الغرفة أحر من السطح.
img: He stands in his dim bedroom with closed curtains, the silent air cooler, sweating heavily, books in his arms. Background: photorealistic hot Baghdad bedroom at noon, light leaking through curtains.

vo: تجرب تدرس بالحمام، لأن الكاشي بارد شوية.
img: He sits on the tiled bathroom floor leaning on the cool wall with a textbook, half funny half desperate. Background: photorealistic old Iraqi bathroom with ceramic tiles, dim light.

vo: أمك تفتح الباب: إنت مخبّل؟ گوم!
img: His mother in a black abaya and headscarf, same 2D cartoon style with round white head, opens the bathroom door with hands on hips, angry; he looks up guiltily. Background: photorealistic Iraqi bathroom doorway.

vo: العصر، تسمع إن الجامع اللي بالمحلة بيه مولدة.
img: He walks down a hot street with books under his arm toward a neighborhood mosque. Background: photorealistic Baghdad street in the afternoon, mosque with a minaret, dust.

vo: تروح، وتلگى عشرين طالب گبلك.
img: Inside a mosque hall, many photorealistic students sit on the carpet with books under a few fans, he stands at the entrance surprised. Background: photorealistic mosque interior, carpets, soft light, a single ceiling fan.

vo: كلهم گاعدين تحت مروحة وحدة، يتقاتلون على الهوا.
img: He squeezes between photorealistic students sitting under one ceiling fan, everyone sweating and leaning toward the airflow. Background: photorealistic mosque interior, carpets.

vo: وبعد ساعة... المولدة تنطفي.
img: The ceiling fan stops, all the students and the hero look up in despair. Background: photorealistic mosque interior suddenly dimmer.

vo: خلص الگاز.
ترجع للبيت، والشمس تغيب.
img: He walks home at sunset carrying books, exhausted. Background: photorealistic Baghdad alley at sunset, orange light, tangled cables.

vo: وتبدي مشكلة الليل.
تولّع شمعة، وتحطها يم الكتاب.
img: He lights a candle next to an open textbook on a small table in a dark room. Background: photorealistic dark Iraqi room, candlelight.

vo: بس الشموع... ست، وصارت خمس.
img: Close-up of a few candles on the table, one already burnt down, he looks at them worried. Background: photorealistic dark room.

vo: وأمك تگول: شمعة وحدة بالليلة، ماكو غيرها.
img: His mother in a black abaya, round white head cartoon style, holds up one finger strictly, a candle between them. Background: photorealistic dark Iraqi living room, candlelight.

vo: تدرس على ضو الشمعة، والبگ يدور حوالين اللهب.
img: He reads by a single candle, mosquitoes and moths circling the flame, squinting. Background: photorealistic dark room, warm candle glow.

vo: عيونك تحرگ، والحروف تتراقص.
img: Close-up of his tired eyes and the blurry textbook lines in candlelight. Background: dark.

vo: وأخوك الصغير يصيح: أكو صوت بالسطح!
img: The little brother, small 2D cartoon boy with round white head and striped shirt, points up at the ceiling scared, the hero looks up. Background: photorealistic dark Iraqi room, candle.

vo: تصعد... وتلگى قطة تاكل بقايا اللحم الخايس.
img: On the dark rooftop his flashlight reveals a skinny street cat eating scraps, he sighs in relief. Background: photorealistic Baghdad rooftop at night, moonlight.

vo: وتگعد بالسطح... تدرس على ضو القمر.
img: He sits on the rooftop holding a textbook up to the moonlight. Background: photorealistic Baghdad rooftop at night, big full moon, dark city.

vo: اليوم الثالث... والرابع... والخامس.
نفس الحر، نفس الظلام، ونفس الكتب.
img: Montage-like wide shot: he studies at the same table, piles of books growing, empty water bottles around, exhausted. Background: photorealistic dim Iraqi room at daytime, harsh light through curtains.

vo: تخسر ثلاثة كيلو، وتصير تحفظ الكيمياء من كثر ما تعيدها.
img: He mutters to himself while walking in circles in the room reading notes, thinner, dark circles under the eyes. Background: photorealistic hot Iraqi room.

vo: وعلي، ابن الجيران، يجيك كل يوم ويدرسون سوا.
img: The hero and the teenage neighbor boy (round white head, short black hair, white shirt) study together on the rooftop at dusk, sharing one book. Background: photorealistic Baghdad rooftop at dusk.

vo: يگلك: إذا نجحنا بهالظروف... نگدر نسوي أي شي.
img: Close-up of the teenage boy smiling determined, the hero nods. Background: photorealistic rooftop at dusk, warm light.

vo: ليلة الامتحان، ما تنام.
img: He lies awake on the rooftop mattress at night staring at the stars, books next to him. Background: photorealistic Baghdad rooftop at night, stars, moon.

vo: تراجع آخر مرة على ضو الموبايل... خمسة بالمية.
img: He reads notes using his phone's flashlight, phone showing a red battery icon. Background: dark rooftop at night.

vo: وينطفي.
صباح الامتحان... الساعة سبعة، والحرارة أربعين.
img: He walks with many photorealistic students toward a school building in the morning, holding a pen and ID card. Background: photorealistic Iraqi school gate, hot morning sun, dust.

vo: المدرسة كلها طلاب، وأهاليهم واگفين برا يدعون.
img: Crowds of photorealistic parents stand outside the school gate praying with raised hands, the hero looks back at them. Background: photorealistic Iraqi school yard, harsh sun.

vo: تدخل القاعة... وتنصدم.
img: He stands at the doorway of an exam hall, shocked. Background: photorealistic dark Iraqi classroom with rows of old desks, windows covered, dim.

vo: القاعة مظلمة، والشبابيك مسدودة، والمراوح واگفة.
img: Wide shot of the dark exam hall with students sitting at desks sweating, silent ceiling fans, light only from small high windows. Background: photorealistic Iraqi classroom.

vo: المراقب يوزع الأسئلة، ويگول: ساعتين... وماكو تمديد.
img: A photorealistic stern exam proctor hands out papers, the hero receives his paper nervously. Background: photorealistic dim exam hall.

vo: تفتح الورقة...
img: Close-up of his mitten hands opening the exam paper. Background: dim exam hall, desk.

vo: وأول سؤال... بالضبط الفصل اللي درسته على ضو القمر.
img: He smiles widely looking at the exam paper, eyes shining. Background: photorealistic dim exam hall, a ray of light falling on his desk.

vo: تكتب... والعرگ يگطر على الورقة.
img: He writes fast with determination, sweat drops falling on the paper. Background: dim hot exam hall.

vo: الطالب اللي يمك يغمى عليه من الحر.
img: A photorealistic student at the next desk faints and slumps, the hero turns alarmed, the proctor rushes over. Background: dim exam hall.

vo: والمراقب يصيح: كل واحد بورقته!
تكمل... وتسلّم الورقة قبل الوقت بدقيقة.
img: He hands his exam paper to the proctor, exhausted but proud. Background: photorealistic exam hall, students leaving.

vo: تطلع برا، وعلي يركض عليك: شلون حليت؟
img: Outside the school, the teenage neighbor boy runs toward the hero excitedly. Background: photorealistic Iraqi school gate, crowds, harsh sun.

vo: تضحك... لأول مرة من أيام.
img: The hero and the teenage boy laugh together, hands on each other's shoulders. Background: photorealistic school street, sunlight.

vo: بس فرحتك ما تكمل.
ترجع للبيت... وتشوف الجيران متجمعين على بابكم.
img: He walks into his alley and sees a crowd of photorealistic neighbors gathered in front of his house door, worried faces. Background: photorealistic Baghdad alley in the afternoon.

vo: وأمك واگفة بالباب... تبچي.
img: His mother in a black abaya, round white head cartoon style, stands at the door crying, wiping tears. Background: photorealistic Iraqi house doorway, neighbors around.

vo: شصار؟
img: Close-up of the hero's frightened face. Background: blurred alley.

vo: اليوم الخامس خلص... وباقي خمسة وعشرين يوم.
